Diego (PM): Thanks for the all-hands — quick clarifying Qs so teams can plan: concrete beta/GA windows for API rate tiers, Console per-route charts, and Optimize recommendation preview?
Samira (CTO): Short list: API rate tiers beta late Sep, GA early Nov; Console per-route charts beta mid-Oct, GA Dec; Optimize preview Nov (manual), automated flows H1 2026. Will lock dates next week.
Nina (Product): Do we have owners for customer comms and SDK guidance? CS needs lead time.
Diego (PM): I'll own the customer one-pager. Nina will lead SDK docs coordination.
Alex Kim: SDK impact? headers/response fields or new endpoints?
Samira (CTO): Minimal surface change: an optional header for tier telemetry and a beta response block for Optimize suggestions. No new endpoints.
Jordan (SRE): Operationally, what's the plan for existing customers when tiers flip? Grandfather or immediate?
Priya (Eng Lead): Plan = 30-day grandfathering + feature-flagged staggered rollout. Fallback policy: soft-throttle -> downgrade model variant -> 429 on burst exhaustion.
release-bot: deploy notice: metrics-pipeline canary started 2024-08-09T14:00:00Z
Diego (PM): Action items: Diego = one-pager by Tue; Nina = SDK doc outline by Fri; Priya = migration guide draft Aug 20; Jordan = canary/runbook thresholds by Aug 10.
Samira (CTO): Good. We'll confirm owners/dates in product leadership sync tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
